narratives.Overview:
Spec is Bound remedy lean 5637548166, not the filed body and not a harvest that recuts SPECIFICATION or agents-entry.

## What to build

Change the framework default for `plan.policy.sessionRitualStalenessHours` from 4 to 8 so every consumer gets one workday of age before ritual re-arm, not a half-day.

Today `packages/core/src/session/staleness.ts` `DEFAULT_SESSION_RITUAL_STALENESS_HOURS = 4`. This repo does not set the typed field, so mutation writes and spawn fail closed after 4 hours until `session:start --rearm` (same worktree, continuous HEAD) or a full cold start. Compact still marks `rearm_needed` independently of age.

Four hours was a half-day bound from #1348, in the same family as the 4-hour D2 triage one-liner, dirty-doctor cache, and `eval:health` debounce. It is too short for a normal workday: a morning ritual should cover the afternoon without a mid-write re-arm. Occupancy is a different clock (`OCCUPANCY_TTL_MS` 20 minutes, `OCCUPANCY_MAX_LEASE_MS` 12 hours). Do not raise occupancy or compact re-arm as part of this.

Do not treat this as a per-project override. The typed field stays (integer ≥ 1) for projects that want a different bound. This issue is the framework default for everyone.

Do not fold #3729 (lease-versus-ritual lifetime). Do not fold #4399 (session:ready skip-drift vs check-class cache_fresh). Do not weaken `verify:cache-fresh` inside `task check`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `DEFAULT_SESSION_RITUAL_STALENESS_HOURS` is 8. Typed `plan.policy.sessionRitualStalenessHours` still wins when set; omit/null still take the new default; invalid values still default-on-error.
- [ ] Schema / SPECIFICATION / `content/commands.md` / agents-entry pointer that currently say default 4 say default 8. Tests that hardcode the default 4 are updated.
- [ ] Compact still marks `rearm_needed` regardless of age. Occupancy TTL and max lease are unchanged.
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry.
- [ ] `task check` passes.

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None -- can start immediately.

#1348, #1149, #2992, #3729 (do not fold), #4399 (do not fold).

## Inventory

- Gate resolver: `packages/core/src/session/staleness.ts:10` unexported `DEFAULT_SESSION_RITUAL_STALENESS_HOURS = 4`. Omit / missing plan / null take source `default`; invalid takes `default-on-error` with the same hours. `verify-session-ritual.ts:348-358` uses that resolver for write/spawn age: `maxAgeMs = staleness.hours * 60 * 60 * 1000`.
- Show surface: `packages/core/src/policy/index.ts:152` **exported** `DEFAULT_SESSION_RITUAL_STALENESS_HOURS = 4`, used only by `inspectSessionRitualStalenessHours` (`policy:show`). Two literals, same name, no import between them.
- Schema: `content/vbrief/schemas/vbrief-core.schema.json:612-615` integer, minimum 1, no maximum, description text "Default: 4." — not a JSON Schema `default` keyword. Same description-only pattern as `forgeOutageRetryMinutes`.
- Docs: `content/commands.md:462` is the live consumer line ("default 4"). `content/templates/agents-entry.md` and managed AGENTS.md name the field and do not print a number.
- SPECIFICATION.md is `AUTO-GENERATED by task spec:render -- DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY`. The only hit is a `[completed]` #1348 acceptance line at 13951-13952, sourced from `xbrief/completed/2026-06-09-1348-session-ritual-verifier-implementation.xbrief.json`.
- This repo `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` `plan.policy` has no `sessionRitualStalenessHours` key, so omit takes the framework default.
- Compact: `markRitualStaleAfterCompact` sets `started_at` to `RITUAL_STALE_EPOCH` (1970-01-01) and `rearm_needed = true`. Comment: instant fail of age checks on any hours horizon. Verifier consults `rearm_needed` only as a message suffix inside the age-failure branch (`verify-session-ritual.ts:358-371`). Raising 4 to 8 cannot green a compacted ritual.
- Occupancy, unchanged: `OCCUPANCY_TTL_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000`; `OCCUPANCY_MAX_LEASE_MS = OCCUPANCY_TTL_MS * 36` (12 hours). Separate clock.
- Sibling 4-hour **nudge** clocks, independent constants: `D2_SUPPRESSION_WINDOW_HOURS = 4`, `EVAL_READBACK_SUPPRESSION_HOURS = 4`, `VALUE_READBACK_SUPPRESSION_HOURS = 4`, dirty-doctor 4h (`content/docs/SUPPORT.md`). They do not share the ritual DEFAULT.
- Tests that assert the **numeric default** is 4: `staleness.test.ts:27` (`result.hours` `.toBe(4)` on missing definition); `policy/resolve.test.ts:686` (`row?.current` `.toBe(4)` on null). Fixture seeds `sessionRitualStalenessHours: 4` in compact/verify/occupancy/cli tests are typed-4, not the default. `commands.md:588` "Fan-out default 4" is triage:evaluate concurrency, not ritual.

## Findings

### 1. sharpens-framing — Name both DEFAULT literals

**Evidence.** `git grep DEFAULT_SESSION_RITUAL_STALENESS_HOURS` at the pin hits two files only: unexported `staleness.ts:10` (gate) and exported `policy/index.ts:152` (show). The issue body and first AC cite only `staleness.ts`.

**Failure mode.** A worker who edits the cited file ships gate-default 8 and `policy:show` still advertising 4. Omit/null consumers then see two answers to "what is the default."

**Disposition.** Scope the AC to both literals. Road-not-taken: export once and import. That would stop a later split, and I would take it if this issue were a SoT refactor. Flip: none — show and gate must stay coupled. This issue is a default bump; naming both sites is enough. Do not invent a third resolver.

### 2. sharpens-framing — SPECIFICATION "default 4" is completed #1348 history, not a live pointer

**Evidence.** SPECIFICATION.md first line forbids hand-edits. The only "defaults to 4" hit is the completed story "Add sessionRitualStalenessHours policy field" rendered from `xbrief/completed/2026-06-09-1348-session-ritual-verifier-implementation.xbrief.json`. Live consumer copy is `commands.md:462` plus the schema description.

**Failure mode.** Honoring "SPECIFICATION … say default 8" as written either rewrites a completed xBRIEF (falsifies what #1348 accepted) or hand-edits a generated file (`verify:spec` freshness fails / next `spec:render` restores 4). Leaving the line means the AC checkbox cannot complete honestly.

**Disposition.** Drop SPECIFICATION and the completed #1348 xBRIEF from the sweep. Record 4 to 8 on this issue, CHANGELOG, schema description, and `commands.md:462`. Do not recut completed-story acceptance text.

### 3. sharpens-framing — "Tests that hardcode the default 4" is two assertions, not every typed 4

**Evidence.** Numeric default asserts: `staleness.test.ts:27`, `resolve.test.ts:686`. Many session tests seed `policy: { sessionRitualStalenessHours: 4 }` so the fixture horizon is typed 4 regardless of DEFAULT. `extra-coverage.test.ts` null path checks `source === "default"` and does not assert hours. Unrelated `toBe(4)` hits include greptile confidence, D2/eval/value suppression hours, and triage fan-out.

**Failure mode.** A grep-for-4 worker rewrites typed-4 fixtures (changes what those tests pin) or "updates" greptile/D2/eval clocks the issue said to leave alone, while missing `resolve.test.ts:686` so `policy:show` still locks 4.

**Disposition.** Update the two default-asserting tests. Leave typed-4 fixtures and the sibling 4-hour nudge constants. Do not treat every `4` as this default.

### 4. footnote — agents-entry does not currently say default 4

AC lists "agents-entry pointer that currently say default 4." Pin text names `plan.policy.sessionRitualStalenessHours` with no number. No numeric edit exists there. Do not insert a number into the always-pin pointer.

### 5. footnote — compact independence is epoch rewind, not a second deny

`rearm_needed` is mark + recovery copy. The deny is `started_at = RITUAL_STALE_EPOCH` through the same age predicate, on any hours horizon. Keep that. Do not add `if (rearm_needed) deny` to "preserve independence," and do not change compact.

### 6. footnote — schema 4 lives in description text

Edit the description to Default: 8. Do not add a JSON Schema `default` keyword; other policy hours fields do not use one.

No blocks-the-design. The 4-to-8 default bump can bind once findings 1-3 restate the AC. Occupancy TTL/max lease and compact re-arm stay out of this issue.
